description: Continuous architecture deepening for the LCA cognitive-agent codebase via the raphy fresh-session loop. Round 1 (this assessment, 2026-10-06): converge duplicated emit/fail builder seams identified by the improve-codebase-architecture skill Explore phase. Out of scope: areas covered by ralph Round 2 (DecisionGates, Ingest pipeline, ContextFiles shims, Read Runs micro-dirs) and lca/cognition/memory/ (frozen per Round 2 AP-01).

userStories.title: Converge duplicated _emit_* no-emitter-fallback methods into a shared assistant event seam
userStories.description: As an LCA maintainer, I want the identical no-emitter-fallback logic in the assistant event emitters converged into one shared seam, so a change to the fallback behavior (log shape, None-emitter handling) is made in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: A single shared helper exists (suggested: lca/plugins/domain/assistant/catalog/events.py or a new lca/plugins/assistant/_shared.py) implementing the seam: if emit fn is None -> log.info('<scope>.ep.no_emitter', ep=<EVENT>, payload=payload.to_dict()); else emit_fn(<EVENT>, payload.to_dict())
lca/plugins/domain/assistant/catalog/events.py _emit_created, _emit_bootstrap_completed, _emit_profile_revised all delegate to the shared helper; no inline if-self._emit-is-None blocks remain
lca/plugins/assistant/tool/overlay.py _emit_profile_revised delegates to the shared helper
lca/plugins/assistant/skill/overlay/overlay.py _emit_installed, _emit_profile_revised, _emit_activated all delegate to the shared helper
A repo-wide grep for 'ep.no_emitter' shows the fallback log call site exists exactly once (in the shared helper)
Behavior preserved: log scope strings per caller (assistant.catalog / assistant.tool_overlay / assistant.skill_overlay) still emitted; payload.to_dict() still passed
Relevant tests pass: uv run pytest tests/ -k 'assistant' --no-cov -q (or the narrower tests covering these three modules)
uv run ruff check passes on all touched files
Do NOT change event names, payload shapes, or the None-emitter fallback semantics
userStories.notes: Source: improve-codebase-architecture skill assessment 2026-10-06 (Strong). Deletion test: yes. Follows the established 'converge N identical X' pattern (git: ba2ad56c6, 2a2059cca). Layering note: verify the import direction for the shared helper creates no new plugin->plugin cycle; prefer the domain catalog module if both overlays already depend on it.

userStories.title: Converge two identical _fail methods in delegate_tool.py into a module-level helper
userStories.description: As an LCA maintainer, I want the two literally identical _fail methods in lca/infrastructure/tools/collaboration/delegate_tool.py converged into one module-level helper, so the validation-failure Observation construction lives in one place.
acceptanceCriteria: A module-level helper (e.g. _fail_observation(start: float, message: str) -> Observation) exists in lca/infrastructure/tools/collaboration/delegate_tool.py with the exact current body (payload={'error': message, FAILURE_KIND: FAILURE_KIND_VALIDATION}, success=False, ContentType.STRUCTURED)
Both tool classes (owners of the current duplicate _fail methods) call the helper; grep -c 'def _fail' on the file returns 0
Do NOT reuse tools._shared.fail_observation: it constructs Observation differently (payload=None, error=, extra=); swapping would change behavior
Behavior preserved: identical Observation fields as before (verified by existing tests or a new unit test pinning the payload shape)
uv run pytest tests/infrastructure/tools/ --no-cov -q passes
uv run ruff check passes on the touched file
userStories.notes: Source: improve-codebase-architecture skill assessment 2026-10-06 (Strong). Deletion test: yes - the two methods are character-identical. Twin of ba2ad56c6 (different Observation shape - do not conflate).

userStories.title: Unify _emit_lifecycle_pre/post/fail in model_visible adapter behind one dispatch seam
userStories.description: As an LCA maintainer, I want the three _emit_lifecycle_* functions in lca/plugins/events/hooks/model_visible/adapter.py unified behind a single dispatch seam, so the step-counter extraction and lifecycle_emit import pattern is not repeated per phase.
acceptanceCriteria: A single seam exists in lca/plugins/events/hooks/model_visible/adapter.py; _emit_lifecycle_pre/post/fail become thin wrappers or call sites of it
The repeated 'step = hook._step_counter' and deferred lifecycle_emit import pattern appears once
Behavior preserved: same lifecycle_emit calls (request_model / complete_model / fail_model) with identical arguments
uv run pytest tests/ -k 'model_visible or lifecycle' --no-cov -q passes
uv run ruff check passes on the touched file
If the three phases turn out to need genuinely different seams, mark this story dropped with the reason instead of forcing unification
userStories.notes: Source: improve-codebase-architecture skill assessment 2026-10-06 (Worth exploring). Weaker than RA-001/RA-002: shared scaffolding but different signatures. Deletion test is marginal.
